title: Direct-image test sections and geometric fibre restriction
statement: Fix shared derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S be flat proper locally of finite presentation [def-weil-flat-morphism,def-weil-proper-morphism,def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], L invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], k:W→S any morphism, and w∈W. Write E=R(f_W)_*(L_W[0]) [def-pc-derived-direct-image,def-pc-base-change,def-pc-module-pullback]. For the derived test groups P and restriction r of [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections], there exists a family of additive equivalences q_t:P(E,t)≅Γ(X×_S T,L_T), for every scheme T and t:T→W. For every open neighbourhood V of w there are j:X×_S Spec κ(w)→X×_S V hitting every point above w [def-weil-residue-field], and e:j*L_V≅L_κ(w). For every ξ∈P(E,V→W), canonical restriction of q_V(ξ) along the tensor-pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], followed by e, is q_κ(w)(r(ξ)). The restriction includes the canonical presheaf map from j inverse top to top. No finite-free model or scalar cycle occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: Invertible L is finitely presented and is flat relative to the flat f, and this remains true after base change to W. Apply canonical arbitrary base change to E for each t:T→W. Derived pullback of L_W[0] is L_T[0] since L_W is flat. Identify Lt*(O_W[0]) with O_T[0]. Derived adjunction, full faithfulness of the single functor, and evaluation of a module morphism on the unit section give the additive equivalence q_t.

Factor the residue point through V by the open immersion lift and use the fibre-product universal property to construct j. The residue fibre projection has image exactly the points above w, so j hits all such points. The two maps to X agree; tensor-pullback composition therefore gives e.

The canonical mate square identifies restriction of the derived test morphism with the ordinary adjunction unit on q_V(ξ). Its degree-zero computation is the canonical degree-zero mate square. Canonical derived composition is exactly the conjugation used in r; tensor-pullback composition transports the coefficient module by e. Evaluation at top and restriction from j inverse top to top produce the displayed equality.

theorem picard_direct_image_test_sections
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) (w : W) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    ∃ q : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W),
        picardDerivedModelSections E t ≃+
          Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L, ⊤),
      ∀ (V : W.Opens) (hwV : w ∈ V),
        ∃ j : pullback f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (V.ι ≫ k),
          (∀ x : (pullback f (V.ι ≫ k) : Scheme.{v}),
            (pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ k)) x = (⟨w, hwV⟩ : V.toScheme) →
              ∃ y, j y = x) ∧
          ∃ e : (Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L) ≅
              (Modules.tensorPullback
                (pullback.fst f (W.fromSpecResidueField w ≫ k))).obj L,
            ∀ ξ : picardDerivedModelSections E V.ι,
              e.hom.app ⊤
                (((Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                  ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L)).presheaf.map
                    (homOfLE j.preimage_top.ge).op
                      (((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
                        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ k))).obj L)).val.app
                          (Opposite.op ⊤) (q V.ι ξ))) =
                q (W.fromSpecResidueField w)
                  (picardDerivedModelRestriction E (picardResidueLift W w V hwV) V.ι
                    (W.fromSpecResidueField w) (picardResidueLift_comp W w V hwV) ξ)
